comparison.objective: Align and slide a carriage onto a rail through a detent; candidate breaks and retrieves insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Close-fit linear insertion and sustained pushing versus coaxial tool placement, impulse regulation, and fragment pickup.
comparison.success_condition: Carriage seats past the plunger at the stop versus four notch fractures with no coil or shell damage.
comparison.reason: The detent click is an assembly latch, not controlled destructive separation.
